verdict.rationale: Self-serve document automation is a fair axis for a law firm, since some firms ship client-facing assembly tools. The evidence here does not show one. The Legaltech page describes internal AI/ML contract review and advisory help for startups 'standardizing their key documents', and Prarambh is an incubator for third-party legaltech startups. Neither is an interactive online document-assembly product that clients can complete themselves.
